title.en: NVIDIA Board reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and director
title.zhHans: NVIDIA 董事会恢复黄仁勋总裁、CEO 及董事职务

searchSummary.en: Eleven days after Huang resigned, NVIDIA's board unanimously reinstated him as CEO following U.S. government input, sending NVDA shares up 31% while its independent inquiry continues.
searchSummary.zhHans: 黄仁勋辞职 11 天后，NVIDIA 董事会在获得美国政府高层意见后全票恢复其 CEO 职务，推动股价单日收涨 31%，同时独立调查仍继续进行。

summary.en: On November 23, 2026, NVIDIA announced that its Board of Directors voted unanimously to reinstate Jensen Huang effective immediately as President, Chief Executive Officer, and Board member, with Harvey C. Jones remaining Board Chair and Colette Kress continuing as CFO. The board cited input from senior U.S. government officials and noted that its independent committee inquiry into foreign-intelligence targeting reports will proceed to conclusion alongside a newly created National Security and Export Control Committee and a search for a new Chief Compliance Officer. NVIDIA shares closed up 31% following the announcement.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 23 日，NVIDIA 宣布董事会一致表决立即恢复黄仁勋总裁、首席执行官及董事职务，Harvey C. Jones 继续担任董事长，Colette Kress 留任 CFO。董事会称已收到美国政府高层意见，同时重申针对外国情报目标报道的独立董事调查委员会将继续推进至结案，并配合新设立的国家安全与出口管制委员会以及启动新设首席合规官（Chief Compliance Officer）招聘。公告后 NVIDIA 股价收盘大涨 31%。

narrative.en: The unanimous reinstatement reversed the November 12 leadership transition just 11 days after Huang's resignation and days after Board Chair Harvey Jones had publicly indicated the board did not intend to reinstate him. Independent reporting by CNBC and NBC News documented White House involvement in board discussions alongside corporate-governance criticism from lawmakers and governance scholars, even as equity markets rallied 31% to recover most of the post-November 8 decline.
narrative.zhHans: 此次全票复职在黄仁勋 11 月 12 日辞职仅 11 天后逆转了管理层交接，且距董事长 Harvey Jones 此前表态无意复职仅数日。CNBC 与 NBC News 的独立报道记录了白宫介入董事会沟通及议员与公司治理学者的质疑；资本市场则迅速反弹，推动 NVIDIA 股价单日收涨 31%，收复 11 月 8 日以来大部分跌幅。

text.en: NVIDIA's Board of Directors voted unanimously on November 23, 2026 to reinstate Jensen Huang effective immediately as President, CEO, and Board member.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 23 日，NVIDIA 董事会一致表决立即恢复黄仁勋总裁、首席执行官及董事职务。

text.en: NVIDIA shares closed up 31% on November 23, 2026 following Huang's reinstatement, recovering most of the roughly 33% drop recorded since November 8.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 23 日黄仁勋复职公告发布后，NVIDIA 股价收盘上涨 31%，收复了 11 月 8 日以来约 33% 的大部分跌幅。

text.en: NVIDIA's independent board investigation remains ongoing, and White House involvement in the board's reinstatement decision drew corporate-governance criticism.
text.zhHans: NVIDIA 独立董事调查委员会的调查尚未结案，而白宫介入董事会复职决策引发了公司治理层面的质疑。

description.en: Immediate 31% single-day market-value recovery in NVIDIA shares upon reinstatement of its founder-CEO, though longer-term compliance and inquiry outcomes remain pending.
description.zhHans: 创始人 CEO 复职触发 NVIDIA 股价单日大涨 31% 的直接市场反弹，但长期合规与调查结果仍有待观察。
